system.description:
Aligned with or trained alongside the Depsopteron dragon-kin — their fighting style reflects the durability and aggression of the dragon-kin culture.

  • Dragon-kin Resilience: Advantage on saves vs fire damage. When using Primeval Will, gain 2 extra bonus HP.
  • Dragon Culture: Advantage on checks involving Depsopteron culture, dragon-kin customs, or identifying Depsopteron-made weapons and armour.
